deferred.summary: npm run shots intermittently writes a real expense to the dev database via the pre-existing gasto-guardando recipe
deferred.evidence: Frontend Phase 2 implementer: 'npm run shots intermittently writes a real $14.000 Transporte expense via the pre-existing gasto-guardando recipe. I removed the three my runs created and left the recipe alone.' Pre-existing, outside this run's slice.

deferred.summary: F1: delete-from-detail replaces the editar entry, so Back lands on the deleted expense's detail (renders 17.11), not the list
deferred.evidence: GastoForm.tsx:468 navigate(desde, { replace: true }) yields stack [lista, detalle, lista'], not the [lista] stated at design.md:582. The push/pop table's mechanism and stack columns disagree; implementer followed the mechanism. Routes to architect.

deferred.summary: F2: useScrollMemory writes scrollTop=0 without guarding restoring.current, so a Finanzas tab switch could overwrite the outgoing key's offset
deferred.evidence: useScrollMemory.ts:57-60 sets el.scrollTop = 0 without setting restoring.current = true (unlike :62); passive cleanup at :51 detaches the listener. Not statically decidable; flagged as a QA probe, not a defect claim.

deferred.summary: F3: the no-history fallback close pushes instead of replacing
deferred.evidence: GastoForm.tsx:242 + Screen.tsx:78 disagree with backToDetalle at Screen.tsx:85 and with design.md:597.

deferred.summary: F4: Mes accepts ?categoria=0, which the backend 400s; Mes renders the 18.10 empty state for it
D4: malformed ?mes= renders a blank month screen (URL-only)
deferred.evidence: /finanzas/mes?mes=no-es-un-mes renders empty <main>. No affordance produces it.

deferred.summary: D5: malformed expense id says the server is unreachable when it is up
deferred.evidence: /finanzas/gasto/abc renders 'No alcanzo tu servidor.' while the server answers. Declared branch: any non-not_found failure shows the unreachable banner. URL-only.

deferred.summary: D6: deleting from a list returns to the top of that list rather than the saved offset
deferred.evidence: Scroll Historial to 250px, open a row, delete it -> land at scrollTop=0. 17.8 governs leaving the detail WITHOUT editing, so unaffected; cosmetic inconsistency.
